tax_litigation.opposing_party: Ajmer Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited, Ajmer
tax_litigation.status: Status quo

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter related to levy of electricity duty on Solar Power Captive consumption (Amount involved Rs.1150 Lakhs) including upto previous year of Rs.989.23 Lakhs .
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Ajmer Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited, Ajmer
tax_litigation.status: The Hon’ble Rajasthan High Court ruled against the Company in the matter of electricity duty on captive solar power consumption. The Company filed SLP (Civil) No. 28095 of 2026 before the Hon’ble Supreme Court on 26 June 2026, which is pending. AVVNL subsequently raised a demand of ₹11.42 crore, including LPS, for five locations. Pursuant to AVVNL’s permission, the Company deposited ₹7.42 crore under protest with the Commercial Taxes Department. The estimated liability for Banswara units is ₹6.83 crore, taking the total identified and estimated liability to ₹14.25 crore. subject to the outcome of the judicial proceedings.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter related to additional stamp duty on execution of supplemental consortuim working capital agreements and joint deeds of hypothecation with Consortium Banks amounting to Rs.1580.87 Lakhs. The Company had filed a case which is pending with High Court of Rajathan, Jodhpur.Last hearing was on 03-01-2025
tax_litigation.opposing_party: State of Rajasthan, Director Gen, State DRI and Collector (Stamps) Bhilwara
tax_litigation.status: Status quo

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter related to reverseal of ITC of Rs.669.13 Lakhs and paid penalty of Rs.100.37 Lakhs (Total 769.50 Lakhs) under section 74(5) on purchases of PET bottles from specific suppliers. We have filed refund claim before Asst Commissioner-CGST Bhilwara on 30-09-2024 but same was rejected. The Company had filed an Appeal before Joint Commissioner (A), Jodhpur against the order.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Asst Commissioner-CGST Bhilwara (In the matter of DGGI, Bangalore)
tax_litigation.status: Hearing Completed on 09-03-2026 and order is awaited. Status quo

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter related to disallowances of deduction U/s 80 IA of Income Tax Act in respect of rate difference on sale of captive power and disallowances of exempt dividend Income U/s14 A for the assessment year 2016-2017 (Amount Involved Rs.813.65 Lakhs). The Company had filed the case and the same is pending with CIT (A), Delhi.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Income Tax, New Delhi
tax_litigation.status: Hearing was fixed on 15-10-2025, but bench could not taken place and next date of hearing is awaited Status Quo

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter related to disallowances of deduction U/s 80 IA of Income Tax Act in respect of rate difference on sale of captive power and disallowances of exempt dividend Income U/s14 A or the assessment year 2017-2018 amounting to Rs.1267.94 Lakhs. The case filed by the company is pending with CIT (A), Delhi.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Income Tax, New Delhi
tax_litigation.status: Hearing was fixed on 15-10-2025, but bench could not taken place and next date of hearing is awaited Status Quo

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter pertains to disallowances of deduction U/s 80 IA of Income Tax Act in respect of rate difference on sale of captive power for the assessment year 2018-19 (Amount Involved Rs.762.72 Lakhs) The case filed by the company is pending with CIT (A), Delhi.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Income Tax, New Delhi
tax_litigation.status: Hearing was fixed on 15-10-2025, but bench could not taken place and next date of hearing is awaited

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Matter pertains to disallowance of Trade Creditors due to non available of balance confirmation letters from CTL for the assessment year 2013-14 (Amount Involved Rs.685.66 Lakhs). Appeal is pending with ITAT, Delhi.Last hearing was on 26-11-2025
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Income Tax, New Delhi
tax_litigation.status: Hearing completed and Case has been reffered to ITAT, Bangalore. Hearing awaited. Status Quo

timeline.summary: Board approved Q1FY27 results and a JV for a ₹186.30 Cr denim garment unit with NDS9 Private Limited.
RSWM reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹1,161 Cr, EBITDA of ₹94 Cr, and PAT of ₹17 Cr, citing operational excellence and improved product mix.
2026-08-11: RSWM announces a joint venture with Spain's NDS9 to establish a ₹186.30 Cr denim garment manufacturing facility in India.
2026-08-14: Income Tax officials visited RSWM corporate office on August 10, 2026, and completed their checking on August 13, 2026
On 2026-08-21, RSWM incorporated the joint venture company LNJ NDS9 Global Private Limited for the denim garment project with NDS9.
RSWM Limited’s 65th AGM on August 26, 2026, passed all six resolutions with full shareholder approval via e-voting and postal ballots, including financial statements and director re-appointment.
2026-10-16: RSWM released FY25-26 sustainability report showing 40.5% reduction in Scope 1 emissions
